name: 王翠花
source: 《八零新婚夜，空间囤货养崽暴富》大嫂

identity.en: A plump twenty-eight-year-old Chinese peasant woman, early 1980s rural northern China
identity.text: 28 岁北方农村大嫂，1980 年代初

face.en: Round full face, thick lips, small shrewd eyes, plump cheeks, ruddy complexion
face.text: 圆脸饱满，厚嘴唇，小而精明的眼睛，脸颊肉实，肤色红润

hair.en: Black hair permed into messy coarse waves, clipped at the side with a bright red plastic hair clip
hair.text: 黑色毛躁烫发，侧边别一只鲜艳红色塑料发卡

top.en: A faded brick-red floral cotton padded jacket, front-buttoned, slightly newer than others but still worn at the cuffs
top.text: 洗旧砖红色碎花粗布对襟棉袄，比别人的略新但袖口仍磨旧

bottom.en: Dark indigo coarse cotton trousers, black cloth shoes

details.en: The bright red plastic hair clip pinned on permed black hair
details.text: 烫发上别着的鲜红塑料发卡

details.en: The brick-red floral padded jacket collar
The frayed cuff of the brick-red floral jacket
details.text: 砖红碎花棉袄磨旧的袖口

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
